mapper.select: select m.message_id, m.consultation_id, m.sender_id, m.sender_type, m.message_type, m.content, m.create_time, u.nick_name as sender_name from t_consultation_message m left join sys_user u on m.sender_id = u.user_id where m.consultation_id = #{consultationId} order by m.create_time asc
